response.justification: Broad, deep engineering experience across web, backend, embedded and infrastructure, with a genuine high-throughput credential (micro-services handling millions of HTTP requests/second at Sociomantic/dunnhumby) and current, directly relevant work on AI-agent infrastructure, MCP code generators and agentic tooling at re:cinq. Strong TypeScript/Node and a demonstrated ownership mindset via founding and maintaining an open-source platform. The main gap is Python, a stated must-have, which appears nowhere in the skills list or role descriptions; recent roles also read as product/full-stack delivery rather than large-scale distributed systems ownership or cross-functional technical strategy. Worth an interview to probe Python depth, distributed-systems recency, and staff-level influence, but not a clear yes on paper.
strengths: Hands-on AI-agent/MCP tooling experience matches the AI-native baseline
Proven high-throughput, low-latency micro-services background (millions of req/s)
Strong craftsmanship culture: TDD, CI/CD, trunk-based, open-source founder
concerns: No evidence of Python, an explicit must-have skill
Recent work skews full-stack product rather than distributed systems at scale
Little demonstrated technical-strategy, stakeholder, or on-call/incident ownership
